island.name: Work & meetings (IT)
island.description: Standups, code review, deadlines and everyday office talk for a developer.

sentences.en: Good morning, shall we start the meeting?
sentences.ro: Bună dimineața, începem ședința?
sentences.note: "Ședință" is the standard word for a work meeting.

sentences.en: Can you hear me well?
sentences.ro: Mă auzi bine?

sentences.en: Yesterday I finished the login page.
sentences.ro: Ieri am terminat pagina de login.

sentences.en: Today I'm working on the database.
sentences.ro: Azi lucrez la baza de date.

sentences.en: I have a problem with the server.
sentences.ro: Am o problemă cu serverul.

sentences.en: The tests don't pass on my machine.
sentences.ro: Testele nu trec pe calculatorul meu.

sentences.en: Can you review my pull request?
sentences.ro: Poți să îmi verifici pull request-ul?
sentences.note: English tech terms take Romanian articles with a hyphen: "pull request-ul".

sentences.en: I'll send you the code this evening.
sentences.ro: Îți trimit codul diseară.

sentences.en: When is the deadline for this task?
sentences.ro: Când e termenul pentru task-ul ăsta?

sentences.en: I think we need another day.
sentences.ro: Cred că mai avem nevoie de o zi.

sentences.en: Sorry, I'm five minutes late.
sentences.ro: Scuze, întârzii cinci minute.

sentences.en: I don't understand the requirement.
sentences.ro: Nu înțeleg cerința.

sentences.en: Who is responsible for this part?
sentences.ro: Cine răspunde de partea asta?

sentences.en: Let's talk about it after the call.
sentences.ro: Hai să vorbim după ședință.
sentences.note: "Hai să" is the natural "let's" in speech.

sentences.en: I'm working from home today.
sentences.ro: Azi lucrez de acasă.

sentences.en: The client wants a change in the design.
sentences.ro: Clientul vrea o schimbare în design.

sentences.en: Can we move the meeting to three o'clock?
sentences.ro: Putem muta ședința la ora trei?

sentences.en: I'm taking two days off next week.
sentences.ro: Îmi iau două zile libere săptămâna viitoare.
sentences.note: "Zile libere" = days off; "concediu" is a longer holiday.

sentences.en: I can't join, I have another call.
sentences.ro: Nu pot să particip, am altă ședință.

sentences.en: Thanks everyone, good work today.
sentences.ro: Mulțumesc tuturor, treabă bună azi.
